name: Roger I of Sicily
role: Grand Count of Sicily from 1071 to 1101
contribution: A Norman nobleman who became the first Grand Count of Sicily from 1071 to 1101.
legacy: By 1090, he had conquered the entire island.
image_credit: An artist from Château de Pirou, Normandia · Public domain

checks.lead: Roger I (Italian: Ruggero; Arabic: رُجار, romanized: Rujār; Maltese: Ruġġieru; Norse: Rogeirr; c. 1031 – 22 June 1101), nicknamed "Roger Bosso" and "Grand Count Roger", was a Norman nobleman who became the first Grand Count of Sicily from 1071 to 1101.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
